title: Battle of Brüx
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Brüx", at revision 1370435407, opens: "The Battle of Brüx was fought on 5 August 1421 in North Bohemia during the Hussite Wars. The Hussite troops, led by Jan Želivský, were defeated by the Catholic Imperial forces of Frederick I of Saxony." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q264911, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Hussite Wars battle in 1421". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
